MOHAMMED HASSAN LUTHFI

mohammedhassanluthfi228@gmail.com| +917328837857 |linkedin.com/in/luthfi24

CAREER OBJECTIVE

Gen AI & Data Engineering professional with 9 years of experience in designing scalable AI solutions and enterprise-grade data platforms, blending expertise in Generative AI, LLMs, RAG pipelines, and multi-modal conversational systems with deep proficiency in Azure-based data engineering. Proven success architecting intelligent, scalable AI solutions and orchestrating agent-driven systems, alongside designing and optimizing big data pipelines using Azure, Databricks, Snowflake, and PySpark.

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Hands-on experience with GenAI and ML platforms—fine-tuning transformers, managing embeddings, or rolling out RAG pipelines

Working knowledge of vector databases (Chroma, Pinecone, Milvus, Weaviate) and model-aware search

Strong foundations in software design, networking, security, observability, and CI/CD

Experience with ML platform and MLOps

Proven ability to drive projects from inception to production and mentor other engineers

Spearheaded the design and deployment of scalable RAG-based chatbots using vector-db and Azure OpenAI, improving customer query resolution accuracy

Strong expertise in Python, Data Lake, Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, PySpark and SQL.

Remarkable communication, analytical skills and self-motivated to take independent responsibility as well as ability to contribute & to be a productive team member.

Experience of designing and developing high-availability Software solutions in Azure cloud environments.

Built reusable Python-based GenAI APIs and workflows for production deployment

Designed scalable AI/ML pipelines using distributed orchestration with Spark, Databricks, and cloud-native services

TECHNICAL SKILLS

AI/ML Tools	: LangChain (Agents, Orchestration, Prompt Engineering), OpenAI GPT, Hugging Face Transformers, Generative AI frameworks, RAG, LangGraph, Agentic AI

Big Data Tools	: Hadoop, HDFS, PySpark, Python Databases	: SQL, Snowflake, SAP HANA Version Control	: MLOps, Azure Devops, GitHub

Cloud Technologies	: Azure Blob Storage, Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS Gen2), Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics



EDUCATION

Master of Computer Applications from Cochin University of Science and Technology, Kerala, India.

BSc. in Computer Science from MIC Arts and Science College, Kerala, India.

WORK HISTORY

Lead Data Engineer – HTC Global Services – May 2024 to Present

Client	: JLL Technologies Designation	: Lead Data Engineer

Tools	: LangChain (Agents, Prompt Engineering, LLM Orchestration), OpenAI GPT / LLMs, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, SQL, Snowflake

Built an agentic AI solution in Databricks that converts natural language queries into SQL statements using LangChain and OpenAI GPT.

Designed a LangChain Agent pipeline that dynamically decides between querying structured data or performing calculations in Spark.

Implemented prompt engineering and schema-awareness to improve accuracy of LLM-generated queries.

Built reusable components and accelerators for agentic AI pipelines.

Investigated and resolved complex edge-case issues across AI pipelines and data workflows.

Incorporated Databricks notebooks and job orchestration for running repeatable AI- powered data workflows.

Conducted data-driven vendor evaluations by benchmarking AI/ML platforms (Azure OpenAI, Hugging Face) using performance, cost, and compliance metrics, enabling informed technology adoption decisions.

Implemented prompt safety, version control, and feedback loops for GenAI apps

Strengthened pipeline security & compliance with role-based access, monitoring, and audit logs

Integrated monitoring, logging, and CI/CD pipelines with Azure DevOps

Senior Big Data Engineer - Enquero – June 2021 to April 2024

Client	: VMware

Duration	: August 2022 – April 2024 Designation	: Senior Data Engineer

Tools	: Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, SQL, RAG, LangChain

Developed a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) chatbot to provide accurate, context-aware answers by combining GPT-3.5/4 with enterprise knowledge bases.

Implemented LangChain and vector databases for efficient embedding-based retrieval and semantic search.

Integrated OpenAI models with LangChain and vector databases to enable context- aware, retrieval-augmented responses.



Ingested data from SAAS application like SAP HANA to Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS Gen2).

Executed a scheduled job to extract data from an Azure SQL database and loaded to data lake.

Handled incremental data using watermark column in Azure Data Factory.

Participated in the estimation, planning, and execution phases, with a strong emphasis on requirement analysis and design.

Client	: Cisco

Duration	: June 2021 – July 2022 Designation	: Senior Azure Data Engineer

Tools	: Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, SQL

Created Data Pipelines to copy data from source to sink.

Developed PySpark code to generate dataframe from raw formatted layers and write them to data service layer tables in parquet format and delta format.

Fine-tuned the jobs to improve source utilization and minimize processing time to obtain Performance Optimization.

Connected API to fetch the data in Azure Data Factory and loaded into ADLS Gen2.

Senior Data Engineer - Mindtree Limited – January 2017 to May 2021

Client	: Adidas

Duration	: April 2019 – May 2021 Designation	: Azure Data Engineer

Tools	: Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, SQL

Optimized the code using efficient file formats and compression techniques.

Implemented SCD 2 for dimensional tables.

Executed process automation and task scheduling using triggers in Azure Data Factory.

Modeled the techniques of Adaptive Query Execution (AQE) dynamically to handle partition skew, coalescing of shuffle partitions, and switching join strategies.

Client	: Unilever

Duration	: Jan 2017 – March 2019 Designation	: Senior Data Engineer Tools	: PySpark, SQL, SAP HANA

Developed PySpark scripts and executed logic in Hadoop according to clients demand and deployed the code.

Applied a range of Spark Transformations and Actions to cleanse the input data.

Documented the data Schemas for the project database to facilitate data analysis.

Tested the data transformation functions to ensure the logic is correct.

Evaluated the SQL scripts and designed them using Spark SQL for better performance.

Modeled the information models using both graphical and SQL scripting methods with different parameters in SAP HANA.
